summary: Directional melee with the felling axe (user 2026-09-27: WASD held at LMB picks the cut, the crosshair where it lands; the counter meets it head on: "counters"). AxeMelee reads it. Swing clips are Actor_B_from_A, none of the tree-chopping ones (atk-pipe-2-side-swing, atk-pipe-1-chop), or this project's own (own-*: animations_extra/Frontier_Own.res, tools/anim_author/; D's, W's and S's key poses were measured off the references named in their "ref", the in-betweens are the solver's own; A is our D mirrored left for right). The stab is this project's own thrust, keyed by hand (tools/anim_author/author_thrust.gd). Times are seconds from the intro's start; strike is the window the edge does damage in (measured: where the hands move fastest).

D.ref: atk-pipe-1-side-swing-intro, atk-pipe-1-side-swing-miss (its key poses measured off them: data/anim_author/axe_swings.json)

A.desc: left to right, two-handed (our own D mirrored: data/anim_author/axe_swings.json axe_a)

W.ref: atk-pipe-3-to-knee-hit-intro, atk-pipe-3-to-knee-hit (its key poses measured off them: data/anim_author/axe_swings.json)

S.desc: the high block (user 2026-09-27: "im thinking we dont even have a rising cut for axes and clubs we just have a parry like two hand hold for the over hand swin"): no attack, the answer to W's overhand chop as the parry (AD) is the stab's; the haft held across above the forehead in both hands (our own, keyed by hand: tools/anim_author/author_high_block.gd axe_block_high); strike is the hold (in time from COUNTER_LEAD before it); no damage

STAB.desc: the stab: a one-handed underhand thrust of the head straight ahead (our own, keyed by hand: tools/anim_author/author_thrust.gd axe_stab); played at rate 0.8, landing about 0.31 s in and slower to recover (the fairness pass: the fastest and longest-reaching attack, reined in)

AD.desc: the parry (user 2026-09-27: "ad should only parry thrusts", "the thrust parry is weird"): our own two-handed sweep of the haft up and out across the chest from the guard, knocking a thrust's point aside (keyed by hand: tools/anim_author/author_parry.gd axe_parry); strike is the sweep (in time from COUNTER_LEAD before it); no damage

contact.summary: Meeting something (MeleeSweep, AxeMelee): the swing is swept a tick ahead from window[0] s before its strike window to window[1] s after; on meeting something it goes back to that moment (bite_m further along for soft things), holds stop_s, runs back recoil_s at recoil_rate (the clip backward: pulled out, or bounced off), then fades to the guard over fade_s. weapon: another weapon (both swings).

cut.summary: A blow into something soft (surfaces) cuts in (user 2026-09-27: 'i still want the crunch maybe go all the way to the spine'): the swing slowed to rate of its pace until the edge is within core_m of the core (MeleeSweep.core_of: a torso's spine, a head's middle), or its path goes no deeper, or max_s has gone; then the core_<surface> hold and pull-out.

stamina._doc: what an attack, the parry and a feint (RMB, a jump or a sprint breaking an attack off) cost of the player's stamina (PlayerGrip.stamina, the climbing grip's; user 2026-09-27, the fairness pass: "attacks, feints and parries cost stamina"): spent as it begins; too little, it does not happen (AxeMelee.pay)

counters._doc: the only blocks (user 2026-09-27: "ad should only parry thrusts and [the] users should only block by counters and thats it"): the counter meets the blow head on; facing each other the side cuts are mirrored (user 2026-09-27: "i forget that it is mirrored for the other player ... if the user does the same attacks it cancel out ... besides the up down and down up"): D meets D and A meets A (each from its own right or left: the two edges come at each other), W is met by the high block (S: no attack, the haft held up across; two W go the same way and both land), the parry (AD) a stab and nothing else; in time it stops the blow, late or early it takes part of its damage (AxeMelee.block_power)
